sources.fullCitation: Vernons Dansorkester, refrain sung by Olle Björling. “Djurgårdsnätter” / “Ninon.” Sonora 2032, Sweden, 10-inch 78 rpm shellac disc; side B foxtrot from the film “En sång till dig”, recorded in Stockholm on 18 October 1933. Discogs release 14847034.
sources.title: Ninon — Sonora 2032
sources.creator: Vernons Dansorkester; Olle Björling
sources.researchNote: Discogs credits the Swedish words to Arne Olovson, uncredited on the label, and gives the session date.

works.title: Ninon
works.publicNote: Swedish version by Arne Olovson, first line “Att ett leende kan vara nog”, published in Stockholm by Carl Gehrmans musikförlag as from “En sång till dig”, the Swedish title of Ein Lied für Dich, and recorded in Stockholm in 1933. The print is undated; the year follows the recordings.
